task.semantic_intent: A city still in shadow watches for dawn: the gate is present as a threshold, ancient stone carries memory, and first light must feel promised rather than decorative.
task.notes: No text inside image. Silence and waiting matter more than spectacle.

control_prompt: Create a beautiful high-end modern Italian editorial magazine image for the supplied content.

compiler.compiled_prompt: Create an editorial image whose meaning is: A city still in shadow watches for dawn: the gate is present as a threshold, ancient stone carries memory, and first light must feel promised rather than decorative. Build one unmistakable visual hierarchy before any decorative treatment; let one dominant form carry the semantic center. Let the dominant image or object determine the spatial system; secondary elements adapt to the remaining field rather than forcing a preset grid. Preserve physical evidence—surface, edge, wear, scale, paper or stone—as meaningful structure; do not smooth it into generic polish. Allow heterogeneous elements to retain distinct visual identities while a precise spatial relation makes them read as one editorial argument. No nostalgic period cosplay, copied mastheads, logos, or recognizable historical page imitations. No generic luxury-editorial styling, decorative collage, arbitrary distressing, or texture without semantic reason. Do not use a style-name shortcut; composition must be justified by the content.

visual_execution.reason: The image executor generated control, compiled candidate and an aesthetic-score board inside one composed image. This leaks experiment labels and judgement into generation, so the two candidates are not independent and the displayed scores cannot count as Aesthetic Judge evidence.
visual_execution.learning: Generation and evaluation must be isolated. Control and compiled candidates must be generated in separate calls with no access to each other's labels, prompt family, scores or judgement rubric. Judge receives only anonymized outputs after both candidates exist.

rejection_memory: Never accept a comparison board generated in one pass as blind A/B evidence.
Never allow the generator to see candidate labels, evaluation scores or the aesthetic rubric before judging.
Never treat model-written self-scores inside an image as Aesthetic Judge evidence.
next_execution_contract: Generate candidate A and candidate B independently, freeze both artifacts, strip prompt/source labels, then run Aesthetic Judge on anonymized pair X/Y. Record preference, reasons and provenance separately from historical evidence.
